🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL, per the supplied regime. Breadth: 11/11 sectors positive; Leadership: intermediate (Top 5 span 3 sectors, neither Narrow nor Broad by the stated thresholds). All-sector weekly gains contrast with major 1W/1M divergences, supporting restraint rather than a strong directional call.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy leads on the week: MPC (1W: +11.24% | 1M: -13.06%) is RECOVERY. Technology is next by weekly sector performance, with AVGO (1W: +18.16% | 1M: +0.78%) ABOVE TREND; Communication also strong, with CHTR (1W: +17.21% | 1M: +25.82%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

Top 5: AMD (1W: +18.93% | 1M: -5.01%) RECOVERY, AVGO (1W: +18.16% | 1M: +0.78%) ABOVE TREND, CHTR (1W: +17.21% | 1M: +25.82%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +12.71% | 1M: -18.58%) RECOVERY, and CEG (1W: +12.10% | 1M: +1.89%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: intermediate (3 sectors represented in the Top 5).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: PFE (1W: -1.70% | 1M: -0.44%) BELOW TREND, NFLX (1W: -1.99% | 1M: -14.41%) BELOW TREND, ISRG (1W: -2.03% | 1M: +3.68%) CORRECTION, NEE (1W: -2.10% | 1M: +7.80%) CORRECTION, and F (1W: -3.10% | 1M: -2.08%) BELOW TREND. Weakness is spread across sectors rather than concentrated in one group.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W moves include AMD (1W: +18.93% | 1M: -5.01%) RECOVERY and AVGO (1W: +18.16% | 1M: +0.78%) ABOVE TREND. The sharp 1W rebounds in AMD (1W: +18.93% | 1M: -5.01%) and LRCX (1W: +12.71% | 1M: -18.58%) are tactical reversals, not confirmed monthly strength.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Weekly sector performance was positive, but the 1M sector average remains negative; stock-level positive counts were not supplied. NVDA (1W: -12.75% | 1M: -25.03%) and MSFT (1W: -1.27% | 1M: -2.88%) are BELOW TREND, while AMD (1W: +18.93% | 1M: -5.01%) is RECOVERY and AAPL (1W: +4.14% | 1M: +4.25%) is ABOVE TREND.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials gained on the week and over the month; stock-level positive counts were not supplied. JPM (1W: +3.50% | 1M: +3.18%), V (1W: +0.92% | 1M: +6.70%), and MA (1W: +1.30% | 1M: +7.28%) are all ABOVE TREND; COF (1W: -3.36% | 1M: -1.90%) is BELOW TREND.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare was positive on both the weekly and monthly sector averages; stock-level positive counts were not supplied. LLY (1W: +6.74% | 1M: +15.47%), JNJ (1W: +3.45% | 1M: +12.82%), and UNH (1W: +3.38% | 1M: +0.19%) are ABOVE TREND, while PFE (1W: -1.70% | 1M: -0.44%) is BELOW TREND.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Keep positioning measured under the supplied NEUTRAL regime; favor confirmed strength in JPM (1W: +3.50% | 1M: +3.18%) ABOVE TREND and LLY (1W: +6.74% | 1M: +15.47%) ABOVE TREND. Style: mixed / no clear leadership; monitor technology divergences rather than treating weekly rebounds as established trends.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: AVGO (1W: +18.16% | 1M: +0.78%) ABOVE TREND and CHTR (1W: +17.21% | 1M: +25.82%) ABOVE TREND, if gains hold; monitor AMD (1W: +18.93% | 1M: -5.01%) RECOVERY for follow-through. BEARISH: NVDA (1W: -12.75% | 1M: -25.03%) BELOW TREND and NFLX (1W: -1.99% | 1M: -14.41%) BELOW TREND remain weak unless momentum improves.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Communication (+3.52% 1W; +5.03% 1M) and Financials (+2.59% 1W; +4.11% 1M) have positive sector averages across both periods. BEARISH: Technology (+4.28% 1W; -9.21% 1M) has a sharp timeframe divergence; stock-level breadth counts were not supplied.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Absolute price levels were not provided, so monitor percentage-trend tests instead: NVDA (1W: -12.75% | 1M: -25.03%) BELOW TREND for continued weakness, and AMD (1W: +18.93% | 1M: -5.01%) RECOVERY for a sustained reversal. JPM (1W: +3.50% | 1M: +3.18%) ABOVE TREND and CHTR (1W: +17.21% | 1M: +25.82%) ABOVE TREND are continuation checks.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
V (+45): analyst target increases cite new growth areas; V (1W: +0.92% | 1M: +6.70%) is ABOVE TREND, confirming the positive tone. Other high-scoring bullish headlines lack corresponding return data in the supplied stock panels, so price confirmation cannot be assessed without inventing performance.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
TSLA (-45): reports of Cybertruck wind-down and a Model Y variant removal diverge from TSLA (1W: +8.93% | 1M: +7.66%) ABOVE TREND. MPC (-45): lower price target contrasts with MPC (1W: +11.24% | 1M: -13.06%) RECOVERY; COF (-45) has confirming weakness at COF (1W: -3.36% | 1M: -1.90%) BELOW TREND, while CHTR (-35) sentiment diverges from CHTR (1W: +17.21% | 1M: +25.82%) ABOVE TREND.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL is the supplied regime; breadth is 11/11 sectors positive, while style remains mixed with no clear leadership. Relative strength includes CHTR (1W: +17.21% | 1M: +25.82%) ABOVE TREND and LLY (1W: +6.74% | 1M: +15.47%) ABOVE TREND. Monitor major timeframe divergence in technology and negative TSLA sentiment against rising price action.
